subject: CS475
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all topics in both English and Arabic. For Arabic 'ScrollView & CardView' and 'layout_weight & Gravity', single videos covering the full topic were unavailable, so the best candidates addressing the core conceptual hurdles were chosen. All other topics have strong, highly relevant selections.

coverage.note: Selected video focuses on gravity vs layout_gravity, as no single eligible video covered all concepts well.
No candidate specifically covered ScrollView with CardView. Selected video teaches the core concept of using a single child (LinearLayout) inside a ScrollView, which is the primary student struggle.

videos.title: ConstraintLayout Tutorial Part 1 - UNDERSTANDING CONSTRAINTS - Android Studio Tutorial
videos.filter_reason: A classic, highly-viewed tutorial that perfectly introduces the fundamental concept of setting constraints for beginners.

videos.title: (#4) Android Weight, Linear Layout Gravity, Padding and Margin- Android App Development
videos.filter_reason: This video is one of the few that explicitly explains and demonstrates layout_weight, gravity, and layout_gravity together, addressing all parts of the student's confusion.

videos.title: CardView and ScrollView in Android 2019
videos.filter_reason: Directly addresses the core problem by explaining that ScrollView needs a single child and demonstrates adding a LinearLayout to hold multiple CardViews.

videos.title: How to Support ALL Screen Sizes on Android - Full Guide
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive guide from a top-tier creator that covers all essential techniques like alternate layouts and dimension resources for supporting multiple screen sizes.

videos.title: 07  Styles and Themes - User Interface| Material Design System | Android App Development in Kotlin
videos.filter_reason: Excellent video that focuses on the practical implementation of Material Design principles through styles.xml and themes.xml, directly addressing the student's struggle.

videos.title: فيديو #69 | ConstraintLayout | شرح مبدأ العمل
videos.filter_reason: A clear and popular video that explains the fundamental working principles of ConstraintLayout, making it ideal for beginners.

videos.title: فيديو #22 | شرح خصائص العناصر [الجزء الخامس]
videos.filter_reason: This concise and highly-viewed video clearly explains the often-confused difference between `gravity` and `layout_gravity`, a key part of the topic.

videos.title: فيديو #121 | عنصر ScrollView وآلية التعامل معه
videos.filter_reason: While not using CardView, this video perfectly explains the core problem: ScrollView's single-child rule and how to solve it using a LinearLayout.

videos.title: درس 139 تصميم لجميع الشاشات Material Design
videos.filter_reason: This video's title 'Design for all screens' is a perfect match, and it teaches the practical use of resource qualifiers like layout-large to create responsive UIs.

videos.title: 24) كورس تصميم تطبيقات الأندرويد - style , theme ,drawable , resource
videos.filter_reason: Directly addresses how to implement design principles in XML by focusing on styles, themes, and resources, which is the core of the student's problem.
